svg.title: Emergency-stop contact, normally closed
svg.desc: Emergency-stop contact, normally closed, IEEE 315-1975 §4.7.2 normally closed pushbutton contact; emergency-stop function is application practice, not a dedicated IEEE 315 symbol. Not in the Schematex circuit exemplar; drawn to its rules with pins on the engine's anchors; one unit is one exemplar pixel. Pins: start (13,8), end (13,68).
